_comment: Single source of truth for the Studyboard capture endpoint contract used by the NATIVE clients (iOS App Intents / Share extension, Android AppFunctions / share receiver) and by tests/capture-contract.test.js. cap-server owns the real function (supabase-functions/capture-task): if it changes a field or limit, change it here too and re-run `node tests/capture-contract.test.js`. STATUS: proposed by the native work; limits must be confirmed against cap-server.

due.note: free text such as 'friday' or an ISO date; the server parses it

response.speech: string (one short sentence, safe to read aloud)

sharedQueueItem._comment: Shape of one item that the native layer (App Group container on iOS, files dir on Android) hands to window.SBCAPTURE.ingest(item) through the StudyboardSharedQueue plugin.
